verses.text: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. But if any man sin and repent, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous;

title: JST, 1 John 2:1. Compare 1 John 2:1 Christ is our advocate with the Father if we repent.
